metadata.title: Host firewall dropped an inbound packet
metadata.description: Migrated from 4.x rule 100400. nftables logged an inbound drop. Hunt tag: platform.firewall

metadata.title: Host authentication or privilege failure
metadata.description: Migrated from 4.x rule 100403. Hunt tag: platform.auth
metadata.author: debian13-secure-platform

detection.condition: failed or invalid or auth_error or sudoers

metadata.title: Identity or source-control authentication failure
metadata.description: Migrated from 4.x rule 100405. Hunt tag: platform.auth
metadata.author: debian13-secure-platform

detection.condition: (authentik_server or authentik_worker or forgejo) and (failed or denied or unauthorized)

metadata.title: Failed user authentication - {{ user.name }}
metadata.description: A Linux audit USER_LOGIN record explicitly reported res=failed. This outcome-qualified rule prevents failed attempts from being presented as successful by local content.
metadata.author: debian13-secure-platform

detection.condition: user_login and failed and not succeeded and not ambiguous

metadata.title: Successful user authentication - {{ user.name }}
metadata.description: A Linux audit USER_LOGIN record explicitly reported res=success. Success is never inferred from the USER_LOGIN event code alone.
metadata.author: debian13-secure-platform

detection.condition: user_login and succeeded and not failed and not ambiguous
